text:
message: I am from a poor family, please help me
reply: 🙏 Sorry, I have nothing that I can give you at this time.
reply: 🙇 In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit ❤️✝️🕊️ : 
🙏 May the LORD have His will done! 🕊️ May the LORD richly bless your family! May the LORD help you! May the LORD lead you to someone who will abundantly provide whatever you ask the same day you ask! Amen! 🙏
